<td class="text"><div style="margin-bottom:9pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">3.&#160;Investment in the Aggregator</span></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-indent:18pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">BXINFRA U.S. recognizes dividend income on the record date of distributions from the Aggregator, if any. BXINFRA U.S. has an interest of 94.5% and 93.1% in the Aggregator as of June&#160;30, 2026 and December&#160;31, 2025, respectively. The remaining interest in the Aggregator is held by a Parallel Fund. BXINFRA U.S.&#8217;s interest in the Aggregator may result in BXINFRA U.S. indirectly holding investments of the Aggregator that, on a proportional basis, at times may exceed 5% of the net assets of BXINFRA U.S. For a listing of investments that may proportionally exceed 5% of BXINFRA U.S.&#8217;s net assets, see the Condensed Consolidated Schedules of Investments of the Aggregator.</span></div><span></span>
